# Ezra Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 469v–470r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** Then Daryavesh [Darius] the-king made [sam] a-decree, and-they-searched [u-vaqaru] in-the-house of-the-books [beit siprayya], where the-treasures [ginzayya] were-deposited [mahhatin] there in-Bavel.

**6:2** And-there-was-found [ve-hishtekachat] in-Achmetha [Ecbatana], the-fortress [birta] which [is] in-the-province [medinata] of-Madai [Media], a-scroll [megillah chada], and-thus it-was-written [ketiv] within-it — a-memorandum [dikronah]:

**6:3** "In-the-year one of-Koresh the-king, Koresh the-king made a-decree concerning the-house of-God [beit Elaha] in-Yerushalayim: let-the-house be-built [yitbene], a-place where they-offer [davechin] sacrifices [divchin], and-its-foundations be-retained [ushowhi mittos'in]; its-height [rumeh] sixty cubits [ammin], its-width [pateyeh] sixty cubits,

**6:4** rows [nidbakin] of-hewn-stone [even gelal] — three, and-a-row of-new timber [a chadath] — one; and-the-expenses [niphqeta] let-them-be-given from-the-house of-the-king [beit malka].

**6:5** And-also the-vessels [ma'anei] of-the-house of-God, of-gold and-silver, which Nevukhadnetsar took-out from-the-temple [hekhala] which [is] in-Yerushalayim and-brought to-Bavel, let-them-be-returned [yetivun] and-go [yihakh] to-the-temple which [is] in-Yerushalayim, to-its-place [le-atreh], and-deposit [ve-tachit] in-the-house of-God."

**6:6** "Now Tattenai, governor of-the-region-Beyond-the-River, Shetar-Bozenai, and-your-companions the-Apharsakhaye who [are] in-the-region-Beyond-the-River — stay-far [rachiqin hevow] from-there.

**6:7** Leave-alone [shevuqu] the-work of-this house of-God; the-governor [pachat] of-the-Yehuda'in and-the-elders of-the-Yehuda'in — let-them-build this house of-God upon its-place.

**6:8** And-by-me a-decree is-made [sim te'em] regarding-what you-shall-do with the-elders of-these Yehuda'in for-the-building of-this house of-God: from the-property [nikhsei] of-the-king, from the-tribute [middah] of-the-region-Beyond-the-River, the-expenses [niphqeta] shall-be-given [mityheva] promptly [osparna] to-these men, so-as-not to-make-them-cease [le-vatala].

**6:9** And-what is-needed [chashchan] — young-bulls [benei torin], and-rams [dikhrin], and-lambs [immerin] for-burnt-offerings to-the-God of-heaven, wheat [chintin], salt [melach], wine [chamar], and-oil [meshach], according-to-the-word [ke-me'mar] of-the-priests who [are] in-Yerushalayim — let-it-be-given [mityhev] to-them day by-day [yom be-yom] without-fail [di la shalu],

**6:10** that they-may-offer [lehevon mehaqqrevin] pleasing-offerings [nichochin] to-the-God of-heaven and-pray [u-metsallayin] for-the-life of-the-king and-his-sons [benowhi].

**6:11** And-by-me a-decree is-made that any-man [kol enash] who changes [yeshanney] this word [pitgama], a-timber [a] shall-be-pulled-out [yitnesiy] from his-house, and-he-shall-be-impaled [yitmechey] upon-it, and-his-house shall-be-made [yit'aved] a-refuse-heap [nevalu] for this.

**6:12** And-the-God who-has-caused-his-name [shemeh] to-dwell [shakkein] there, may-he-overthrow [yemagger] any king or-people who stretches-out his-hand to-change [le-shahnayah] or-destroy [le-chabbala] this house of-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim. I, Daryavesh, have-made a-decree; let-it-be-done [yit'aved] with-diligence [osparna]."

**6:13** Then Tattenai the-governor of-the-region-Beyond-the-River, Shetar-Bozenai, and-their-companions — according-to-what Daryavesh the-king sent, thus promptly [osparna] they-did.

**6:14** And-the-elders of-the-Yehuda'in were-building [banin] and-prospering [matzlchin] through-the-prophesying [bi-nvu'at] of-Chaggai the-prophet and-Zekharyah son of-Iddo; and-they-built and-completed [shakhliluv] by-the-decree [min ta'am] of-the-God of-Yisra'el and-by-the-decree of-Koresh and-Daryavesh and-Artachshasta king of-Paras.

**6:15** And-this house was-completed [ve-shitsiy] on the-third day of-the-month Adar [Adar], which was the-year six of-the-reign of-Daryavesh the-king.

**6:16** And-the-sons of-Yisra'el, the-priests and-the-Levites and-the-rest of-the-sons of-the-exile [benei galuta], made [avadu] the-dedication [chanukkat] of-this house of-God with-joy [be-chedvah].

**6:17** And-they-offered for-the-dedication of-this house of-God: bulls [torin] — one-hundred; rams [dikhrin] — two-hundred; lambs [immerin] — four-hundred; and-male-goats [tsefirei izzin] as-a-sin-offering [chattaya] for all Yisra'el — twelve, according-to-the-number [le-minyan] of-the-tribes [shivtei] of-Yisra'el.

**6:18** And-they-set [va-haqimuv] the-priests in-their-divisions [peluggatehon] and-the-Levites in-their-courses [mahleqatehon] for-the-service of-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim, as-written [ki-khetav] in-the-book of-Mosheh.

**6:19** And-the-sons of-the-exile [benei ha-golah] kept [vaya'asu] the-Pesach [Passover] on-the-fourteenth of-the-month the-first [ha-rishon].

**6:20** For the-priests and-the-Levites had-purified-themselves [hittiaharu] as-one [ke-echad]; all-of-them [kullam] were-pure [tehorim]. And-they-slaughtered [vayishchatu] the-Pesach for-all the-sons of-the-exile and-for-their-brothers the-priests and-for-themselves.

**6:21** And-the-sons of-Yisra'el who-had-returned from-the-exile ate [vayokhelu], and-everyone who-had-separated-himself [ha-nivdal] from-the-uncleanness [mittumat] of-the-nations [goyei] of-the-land to-them, to-seek [lidrosh] YHWH the-God of-Yisra'el.

**6:22** And-they-kept the-feast of-Matstsot [Unleavened Bread] seven days with-joy [be-simchah], for YHWH had-made-them-joyful [simmecham] and-had-turned [hesev] the-heart [lev] of-the-king of-Ashur [Assyria] upon-them, to-strengthen [lechazzeq] their-hands in-the-work of-the-house of-God, the-God of-Yisra'el.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — Ecbatana:** The scroll was found not in Babylon but in *Achmetha* (Ecbatana), the old Median capital and summer residence of Persian kings. This is a historically plausible detail — royal archives were distributed across multiple capitals.

**v.14 — Triple authorization:** The remarkable phrase "by the decree of the God of Israel and by the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes" places divine authority first and coordinates it with three successive Persian kings, collapsing the chronology into a single theological statement: God and empire together authorized the temple.

**v.22 — "king of Assyria":** The unexpected term *melekh Ashur* for Darius is striking. The Persian king is called "king of Assyria" because Persia now ruled the Assyrian territories. This deliberate anachronism may also evoke the Assyrians who first caused Israel's exile, completing a theological circle.

*— EMET*
